name: plugins
description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
one_liner: A library of ready-made add-ons for the Cursor code editor that teach its AI assistant how to work correctly with specific tools and frameworks.
buyer: A SaaS company that wants its product's docs and APIs baked into Cursor as an official integration, so developers using their product get accurate AI help by default.
business_use_cases: A SaaS tool vendor publishes an official Cursor plugin so developers using their API get correct autocomplete and best-practice guidance, driving platform adoption.
A dev consultancy builds client-specific plugins, such as a company's internal coding standards, and reuses the same spec across multiple engagements.
A solo developer builds a plugin for a popular framework that has no official coverage yet, to build personal reputation in the Cursor community.

money_ideas.idea: Get hired by SaaS vendors to build and maintain their official Cursor integration plugin as an ongoing contract.

steal_this: Find a popular developer tool with no official Cursor plugin yet, build one this weekend using the spec, and pitch it to that tool's developer-relations team.
